title: Cohomology on the set of specialisations of a quasi-compact subset as a colimit over its neighbourhoods
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter cohomology.tex (Cohomology of Sheaves)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a spectral space X, an abelian sheaf F and a quasi-compact subset E, the lemma expresses the cohomology on the set W of points specializing to a point of E as a colimit of the cohomologies of the quasi-compact open neighbourhoods of E, and gives the analogous statement for the complement when E is constructible (statement lines 3869-3881). The proof identifies W as the inverse limit of the quasi-compact open neighbourhoods of E, notes that each of those is a spectral space, and applies the colimit formula for cohomology on spectral spaces to obtain the first statement (proof lines 3884-3888). The second statement is obtained by the same argument with the variant of the structure theorem for the complement of a constructible subset (proof lines 3889-3890). The claim is H2: one structure theorem plus one colimit formula, applied twice, with no additional construction.
